whatIs: Layers is a community where designers and studios publish their work: interface concepts, animations and product pieces. Besides the post feed, it has profiles of rising designers, a section of industry news with voting, and a job board.
It's useful for seeing what people who design every day are doing and following whoever interests you, more than for browsing an organized catalog.
uses: Follow designers or studios whose style you like and see their new posts in your feed.
Look at interface concepts and flow animations for inspiration before proposing a screen.
Check the news section to keep up with changes in tools like Figma or Adobe.
caveats: The style tags (Minimalist, Landing Page, SaaS, Dashboard…) and the search help, but the content is a community feed and quality varies from post to post.
Many posts are portfolio concepts, not real products in production.
You need to sign up to follow accounts and take part.
pricingNote: Browsing and signing up are free.
idealFor: Anyone who wants inspiration from the design community's recent work.
